description: Utility class for constructing file paths for images in a web-based e-commerce application. Provides static methods to generate URLs for static content, manufacturer images, product images, store logos, and product properties based on store data and content types.

classes.name: ImageFilePathUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate various image file path URLs for different content types and entities within the e-commerce platform.

methods.name: buildStaticImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path URL for static images used by the image servlet.

methods.name: buildManufacturerImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path URL for manufacturer images.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path URL for product images, given a Product object.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path URL for product images, given a SKU string.

methods.name: buildLargeProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path URL for large product images.

methods.name: buildStoreLogoFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path URL for store logos.

methods.name: buildProductPropertyImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path URL for product property images.
